identity.title: List of English language Rival Destinies home video releases (Region 4)

leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifteenth season of , Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifteenth season of , Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
 
Two Rival Destinies Collections were released by in 2013, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 1 was released by in Australia on February 3, 2013 and in New Zealand on January 19, 2013. It contains three discs with 25 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4358.

====Contents====
 

===Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 2 was released by in Australia on June 5, 2013 . It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4359.

====Contents====
 

==Season 15 disc set==
 
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010.

The Season 15 DigiPack disc set was released by in Australia on October 2, 2013 and in New Zealand on October 16, 2013. It contains six discs with 49 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4875. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case on April 2, 2014 in Australia with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5399.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Rival Destinies episodes.
Pokémon Unova Collection
Pokémon: Heritage Collection II
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
